info.title: Credits Usage API
info.description: Retrieve the remaining and consumed API credit balances for the authenticated organization. Returns subscription-plan credits, subscription surcharge (overage) credits, and one-off credit purchases as separate balances, each with allowed and used counts. Only an organization admin API key can call this endpoint; all other keys receive a 403. There are no optional data modules for this endpoint — the response always includes the full credit breakdown.

get.summary: Get remaining and consumed API credit balances for the organization
get.description: Returns subscription, subscription-surcharge, and one-off credit balances for the authenticated organization's account.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

403.description: Forbidden — Caller is not an organization admin

value.message: You need to be organization admin to access this endpoint.

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

CreditsUsageResponse.description: Credit balances for the organization's subscription, subscription surcharge, and one-off purchases.

apiKey.description: The API key the credit balances belong to.

subActive.description: Whether a subscription plan is currently active. Null if the account has no subscription.

subStatus.description: Status of the subscription credits. Null if the account has no subscription.

subAllowedCredits.description: Total credits allowed under the subscription plan. Null if the account has no subscription.

subUsedCredits.description: Credits consumed under the subscription plan. Null if the account has no subscription.

subSurchargeStatus.description: Status of the subscription surcharge (overage) credits. Null if the account has no subscription.

subSurchargeAllowedCredits.description: Total surcharge credits allowed. Null if the account has no subscription.

subSurchargeUsedCredits.description: Surcharge credits consumed. Null if the account has no subscription.

subSurchargeAllowed.description: Whether surcharge (overage) usage is allowed on the subscription. Null if the account has no subscription.

oneOffCreditsActive.description: Whether the account has active one-off (pay-as-you-go) credits.
